question: What constitutes the root Kaula in relation to the attainment of the eight powers?
premises: The eight powers are under consideration.
Their attainment is identified with a foundational principle.
This principle is named the root Kaula.
inference: The attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The precise scope of the eight powers is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: And, O fair-faced one, the attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula.
